Furthermore, owing to a contractual exclusivity clause, the final routing plan must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical corridors: the link between Hub Beta and Hub Gamma, or the link between Hub Gamma and Hub Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total distance circuit that visits every hub precisely a single time and concludes at the point of origin.
